visual_elements.description: Transformer architecture diagram in a green-bordered rounded frame split into two panels: LEFT panel labeled 'Encoder' (red italic, top-left) with pale peach fill; RIGHT panel labeled 'Decoder' (green italic, top-right) with pale green fill. ENCODER STACK (bottom to top): bold text 'Inputs' with a thick red up block-arrow into tan box 'Input Embedding'; thin black arrow up to a circle containing a ⊕-style symbol labeled 'Positional Encoding' (two-line label at its left); arrow up into tan box 'Multi-Head Attention' whose bottom receives three small letter-circles V (blue), K (blue), Q (red) all fed from the positional-encoding output (self-attention); arrow up to tan box 'Add & Norm'; arrow up to tan box 'Feed Forward'; arrow up to tan box 'Add & Norm'. A gray circle 'N x' sits at mid-height left of this stack (repeat notation). From the top 'Add & Norm', V (blue) and K (blue) branch rightward into the decoder — these crossing paths are emphasized with a yellow highlight band. DECODER STACK (bottom to top): bold text 'Outputs' (yellow-highlighted) with '(shifted right)' beneath it; thick red up block-arrow into dark-red box 'Output Embedding'; arrow up to a ⊕ circle labeled 'Positional Encoding' (two-line label at its right); arrow up into purple box 'Masked Multi-Head Attention' with V (blue), K (blue), Q (red) circles at its bottom; arrow up to tan 'Add & Norm'; arrow up to tan 'Multi-Head Attention' receiving V (blue) and K (blue) from the encoder (yellow-highlighted paths) and Q (red) from below; arrow up to tan 'Add & Norm'; arrow up to tan 'Feed Forward'; arrow up to tan 'Add & Norm'; gray circle 'N x' at right of the stack; arrow up to light-green box 'Linear'; arrow up to light-green box 'Softmax'; arrow up to bold text 'Output Probabilities' with a thick red up block-arrow. A red DASHED curved arrow runs from 'Output Probabilities' down the right edge to 'Outputs (shifted right)' (autoregressive feedback loop). 'Add & Norm' appears 5 times total (2 in encoder, 3 in decoder); 'Feed Forward' 2 times; 'Multi-Head Attention' 2 times; 'N x' 2 times; 'Positional Encoding' 2 times.
